source: MoHFW / NHM ASHA Module 6 & 7: Skills That Save Lives
citation: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. Home Based Newborn Care & Maternal Health Danger Signs.

pregnancy_and_postpartum.name: Vaginal bleeding / bleeding in pregnancy
pregnancy_and_postpartum.action: Immediate referral to Primary Health Centre (PHC/FRU)

pregnancy_and_postpartum.name: Severe headache / blurred vision / convulsions
pregnancy_and_postpartum.action: Immediate referral to Primary Health Centre (PHC/FRU)

pregnancy_and_postpartum.name: High fever with chills or foul discharge
pregnancy_and_postpartum.action: Immediate referral to Primary Health Centre (PHC/FRU)

newborn_and_child.name: High fever / child unusually cold to touch
newborn_and_child.action: Immediate referral to Primary Health Centre (PHC/FRU)

newborn_and_child.name: Unable to breastfeed / poor sucking
newborn_and_child.action: Immediate referral to Primary Health Centre (PHC/FRU)

newborn_and_child.name: Fast breathing / chest indrawing
newborn_and_child.action: Immediate referral to Primary Health Centre (PHC/FRU)

newborn_and_child.name: Convulsions / lethargy / unconsciousness
newborn_and_child.action: Immediate referral to Primary Health Centre (PHC/FRU)
